title: The 10 Best Laser Distance Measures
subtitle: Laser measures for rooms, flooring, paint estimates and outdoor distances, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A laser distance measure reads distance with a button press, then works out area, volume and height for you. We ranked 10 best-sellers from Bosch, Klein, MILESEEY, RockSeed, DTAPE and Fanttik on rating, review volume and features (±1/16 inch accuracy, 165 ft or more range, a green beam and angle or app functions). Even the cheap ones are accurate enough for most home projects.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

products.name: MILESEEY D5 Laser Measure with Angle Sensor, 229 ft
products.best_for: DIYers who want angle and indirect height measurements cheaply.
products.verdict: A budget laser measure with an electronic angle sensor, 229 ft range and ±1/16 inch accuracy, rated IP54 with a 2-year assurance.

specs.extras: Electronic level ±0.3°, angle sensor, IP54, 2-year assurance

products.name: RockSeed S2 Digital Laser Distance Meter with 2 Bubble Levels, 165 ft
products.best_for: Homeowners measuring rooms for flooring and paint.
products.verdict: Tied for the best seller and the most-reviewed laser measure here: 165 ft range, ±1/16 inch, two bubble levels, area and volume modes, IP54, for about $24.

products.name: Bosch GLM165-40 Blaze Pro 165 Ft. Laser Measure
products.best_for: Contractors and DIYers who want a reliable everyday laser measure.
products.verdict: The best-rated laser measure here: pocket-size, 165 ft range, ±1/16 inch accuracy, a real-time mode that updates as you move and an IP54 rating against rain and dust.

specs.extras: Real-time mode, backlit display, IP54, wrist strap

products.name: DTAPE High-Accuracy Laser Measure, 2" Backlit LCD, 330 ft
products.best_for: DIYers who want long range for little money.
products.verdict: A budget meter that claims ±1/16 inch out to 330 ft, with IP54 sealing, a large backlit display and manual calibration.

products.name: Bosch GLM165-25G Blaze Green-Beam 165 Ft. Laser Measure
products.best_for: Pros who measure in bright light.
products.verdict: Bosch's green-beam version of its 165 ft measure: a dot up to 4 times brighter than red, easier to see in bright rooms and outdoors.

products.name: MILESEEY S50 Green Laser Distance Meter, 400 ft, P2P

products.verdict: A feature-packed green-beam meter with 400 ft range, point-to-point measuring, 18 modes and an app, for less than half the price of Bosch's outdoor model.
cons: Accuracy not stated in the bullets

specs.extras: Point-to-point, 18 modes, app with cloud sync, case

products.name: BOSCH GLM100-23 100 Ft Blaze Laser Distance Measure
products.best_for: Anyone who wants the simplest name-brand laser measure.
products.verdict: Bosch's simple two-button laser measure: 100 ft to within 1/16 inch, with nothing to learn.

products.name: BOSCH PRO GLM400C BLAZE Outdoor 400 Ft. Connected Laser Measure
products.best_for: Surveying yards, lots and building exteriors.
products.verdict: Bosch's outdoor meter uses a 5-megapixel zoom viewfinder to find the dot at 400 ft, with Bluetooth to send measurements to your phone and a 360-degree inclinometer.
cons: Accuracy not stated in the bullets

products.name: Fanttik A10 Pro 2-in-1 Digital Laser Tape Measure, 165 ft
products.best_for: Gadget lovers who want a tape and a laser in one.
products.verdict: A laser measure and digital tape in one, with a color screen, a ±1° angle readout and USB-C charging. The laser side is ±1/8 inch, less precise than most here.

specs.extras: Color IPS display, dual-axis angle, 30 saved readings

products.name: Klein Tools Laser Distance Measure, 100 ft (93LDM100C)
products.best_for: Electricians who want a pocket-size measure on their belt.
products.verdict: A pocket-clip laser measure from Klein with a reverse-contrast display that reads well in dim rooms, accurate to ±1/16 inch out to 30 ft.

avoid.name: ACEGMET S9 229ft/70m Laser Measuring Tool, LCD Backlit Display
avoid.flag: Title says 229 ft; listing says 393 ft
avoid.verdict: The listing can't agree on how far the laser reaches, which is the main spec of a laser measure.
reasons: The title says '229ft/70m', but the bullets say 'Its laser extends out to 393 feet'.
Range is the spec you compare laser measures on, and here you can't tell whether you're buying a 229 ft or a 393 ft tool.
For a few dollars more, the RockSeed S2 lists its range and accuracy consistently and has 22,552 reviews.

buyers_guide.a: Most here are rated ±1/16 inch, as good as a careful tape measure, over their full range. Klein rates its 100 ft model ±1/16 inch to 30 ft. Accuracy drops on shiny, dark or angled surfaces; put a card or tape on glass.

buyers_guide.q: How much range do I need?
buyers_guide.a: Indoors, 100 ft is plenty for almost any room. 165 ft covers big rooms and halls. 300 to 400 ft matters outdoors, where you'll need a target, a green beam or Bosch's camera viewfinder to see the dot.
Green dots look up to 4 times brighter than red, so they're easier to see in sunlit rooms and outdoors. They cost more and use more battery.
Most here do area (two measurements multiplied), volume and Pythagorean height. That's handy for flooring and paint estimates.
Some dual-laser models advertise the two directions added together, so a '656 ft' meter reaches 328 ft each way. Check the single-direction range.
